settings.a: Yes. Your account is free and starts at Bronze with [welcome] welcome points.
Sign in before you check out, online or in store. Bronze earns [bronze], Silver [silver] and Gold [gold] back in points on your order subtotal.

settings.q: How do I move up to Silver or Gold?
settings.a: We add up your paid orders over the year. Silver starts at [silver_from] and Gold at [gold_from].
At [redeem] points, open your account dashboard and choose Trade [redeem] points. We email you [reward] off.

settings.q: What happens when I refund an order?
settings.a: The points from the refunded amount come off your balance, so it stays correct.

settings.q: Why hasn't my tier or balance updated yet?
settings.a: Points and tiers update once a paid order syncs. Use the same email at checkout as on your account so the order counts.

settings.heading: Every order *pays* you back
settings.lead: Earn [bronze] back in points on every order, online or in store. Spend more in a year and it goes up to [silver], then [gold].
